# Antioch

## Doctors of Physical Therapy

### Welcome to DPT - Antioch!

At our Antioch physical therapy clinic, we provide compassionate, evidence-based care. Every patient receives individualized treatment from an expert clinician. Whether you’re recovering from injury or surgery or simply addressing a longtime ache or pain that keeps you from optimal function, we’re here to help you get better, faster!

Here in Antioch, we also offer [pelvic floor physical therapy](https://doctorsofphysicaltherapy.com/our-services/pelvic-floor-therapy/) and women’s health services in addition to great orthopedic care!

You can call or click today to schedule your FREE consult and your first visit with our expert physical therapist in Antioch, IL.

We can’t wait to see you!

### Find us Here

543 Orchard St.

Antioch, IL 60002

### Get In touch

Phone: 847-395-6100

Fax: 847-395-6162

### Clinic Hours

Mon: 8am- 7pm

Tues: 8am- 7pm

Wed: 8am- 7pm

Thurs: 8am- 7pm

Fri: 8am- 7pm

Saturday: Closed

Sunday: Closed
